prompt: Round 2 of 6. The company side proposes (We need a calculation engine we can own and maintain directly inside NjivaManager, which we intend to offer as a standa

content.text:
Key issues with their proposal:
1. IP: company_owns_uni_academic_use - I need uni ownership. Must change to uni_owns_option_to_licence or similar.
2. Publication: 60 days review - I can accept 30 or 60; 60 is at the high end but acceptable if I get IP.
3. Exclusivity: 18 months, broad field - acceptable duration but field is very wide.

I'll propose: uni_owns_option_to_licence (gives company ability to license) and reduce publication to 30 days. Trade: give on exclusivity (keep 18 months) to get university ownership.
